contexts.text: We will pass the night in the street () = that He was as it were willing to judge from truth... To pass the night, here, = to judge. Explained.
Is there room... for us to pass the night? () = a state of remaining. AC 3115.
They passed the night () = the peace thereof; (for) to pass the night is to rest; and, in the internal sense, to have peace. Explained.
To pass the night in the forest () = to be desolated as to good. (Compare AC 3268:7.)
They passed the night there because the sun was set () = life in what is obscure; (for) night = a state of shade; thus to pass the night = to live in that state. Explained.

They passed the night in the mountain () = tranquility... That those who had entered into a covenant should pass the night in one place, was a ritual, because a passing of the night in one place signified that there was no longer any hostility; in the internal sense, that there was tranquility and peace...
He passed the night there in that night () = in that obscure slate.
That he was not to pass the night upon the wood () = perpetual rejection; for in the evening the day commenced anew...
This Natural is... a place of rest or of passing the night for scientifics.

The fat of My feast shall not pass the night even to the morning () = the good of worship not from proprium, but always new from the Lord; (for) to pass the night = that which is from proprium; for by night, in the Word, is signified evil and falsity; thus also proprium.
The sacrifice of the feast of the passover shall not pass the night to the morning () = the good of worship not from proprium, but from the Lord always new.
As yet no hope of deliverance is signified by... I will pass the night in the wilderness ().
To pass the night in the wastes () = to remain and live in falsities.
Full of judgment, justice passed the night () = where the truth of doctrine and the good of love were in abundance.
